name: Database Management Systems
description: Introduction to database systems, relational data model, ER modeling, SQL queries, normalization (1NF to BCNF), transaction management, ACID properties, and indexing techniques.

name: Data Structures and Algorithms
description: Analysis of algorithms, asymptotic notation, linear data structures (stacks, queues, linked lists), non-linear data structures (trees, heaps, AVL, B-trees, graphs), sorting and searching algorithms.

name: Operating Systems
description: Process management, threads, CPU scheduling algorithms, synchronization (semaphores, mutexes), deadlocks, virtual memory, paging, segmentation, and file system management.

name: Discrete Mathematical Structures
description: Propositional and predicate logic, set theory, relations, equivalence relations, partial orderings, functions, recurrence relations, graph theory, and trees.

name: Computer Networks
description: Layered network architecture, OSI and TCP/IP reference models, data link protocols, IP addressing, routing algorithms (OSPF, BGP), transport layer (TCP/UDP), socket programming, and network security.

name: Computer Architecture and Organization
description: Von Neumann architecture, instruction cycle, register transfer logic, arithmetic logic unit, pipelining, hazards, memory hierarchy, cache mapping, and I/O interfacing.

name: Software Engineering
description: Software development life cycles (SDLC), Agile and Scrum methodologies, UML modeling, requirements engineering, software architectural patterns, unit testing, and continuous integration.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: State-space search (BFS, DFS, A*, minimax with alpha-beta pruning), knowledge representation, probabilistic reasoning, introduction to machine learning, and artificial neural networks.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Cloud service architectures (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), virtualization technologies, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), AWS cloud services, and cloud security.

name: Mathematics - I
description: Differential and integral calculus, Taylor series, partial differentiation, vector calculus, matrices, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and ordinary differential equations.

name: Electrical Engineering
description: Network theorems (Thevenin, Norton, Superposition), AC single-phase and three-phase circuits, transformers, DC/AC motors, and basic electrical measurements.

name: Applied Physics
description: Electromagnetic theory, Maxwell's equations, lasers and holography, optical fibers, quantum mechanics, wave-particle duality, and solid-state materials.

name: Computer Programming
description: Problem-solving techniques, structured programming in C/C++, variables, control flow, functions, arrays, pointers, structures, file handling, and dynamic memory allocation.
